Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.

As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About the Role:  

The Director of Sales, Europe will be responsible for leading our regional sales organization, driving Planet’s Go-To-Market (GTM) strategy, and accelerating revenue growth across national security, defense, and government sectors.

As a people manager and business leader, you will own the regional revenue target, drive executive alignment, and establish disciplined pipeline governance to ensure forecast predictability. You will be responsible for building, mentoring, and coaching a team of direct reports—fostering a culture of accountability, operational excellence, and continuous professional development. In addition to team development, you will architect large-scale strategic programs, lead high-stakes commercial negotiations, and scale partner ecosystems to penetrate priority markets. Above all, you will leverage your leadership experience to elevate Planet’s market presence across NATO and the Nordics in alignment with our mission to see change and change the world.

The ideal candidate is an accomplished sales leader with deep defense domain expertise and a track record of managing high-performing teams across Alliance structures and Northern European markets. You will bring an established executive network spanning NATO HQ, allied Defense Ministries, Armed Forces Commands, Intelligence Agencies, and key European Prime Contractors/System Integrators. Combining strategic commercial acumen with an understanding of collective defense and national security priorities, you will position Planet as a trusted capability provider for mission-critical operations.

This is a full-time, remote position based in the United Kingdom or Germany. If located near an office, you are expected to work from that office 3 days per week.

Impact You’ll Own:

  • Drive Strategic Revenue Growth: Own and execute a result-oriented Go-To-Market (GTM) strategy to build, negotiate, and close high-value, complex deals across sovereign defense and government sectors, consistently hitting or exceeding regional quota targets.
  • Forecast Governance & Predictability: Maintain rigorous pipeline hygiene (Salesforce.com) and deliver accurate, data-driven revenue forecasts to executive leadership through disciplined deal inspection and pipeline management.
  • Capture Strategy & Value Messaging: Engineer tailored capture strategies and high-impact executive narratives that align with agency-level priorities, resonate with key decision-makers, and win competitive procurements.
  • Manage, Coach & Empower: Build, mentor, and scale a high-performing sales team, establishing a culture of accountability, operational excellence, and continuous professional development.
  • Methodology Alignment: Train and inspect direct reports on core sales methodologies and capture frameworks (e.g., MEDDPICC, Shipley), coaching them on deal qualification, stakeholder mapping, and win strategies.
  • Talent Bench & Scaling: Proactively recruit, onboard, and retain elite commercial and defense-domain talent to build a solid talent bench as the regional footprint expands.
  • Cross-Functional Matrix Alignment: Orchestrate seamless collaboration across internal matrix teams including Government Affairs, Product, Engineering, and Field Marketing to align corporate capabilities with regional market opportunities.
  • Technical & Post-Sales Win Alignment: Partner closely with Pre-Sales/Solutions Engineering to secure technical wins, and collaborate with Post-Sales teams to ensure flawless customer onboarding, retention, and long-term expansion.
  • Deal Cadence & Executive Escalation: Communicate deal velocity transparently across internal business units, mobilizing executive sponsorship and cross-functional support when needed to de-risk complex pursuits.

What You Bring:

  • 8+ years of relevant work experience and 6+ years supervisory / leadership experience, with a track record of driving revenue growth, building high-performing teams, and consistently exceeding multi-million-dollar individual and team quotas.
  • Ability to recruit, mentor, and retain top-tier talent, instilling a high-accountability culture and coaching direct reports through complex, multi-year deal cycles.
  • Deep experience establishing pipeline discipline, accurate revenue forecasting, and thorough deal inspection using Salesforce.com and modern sales methodologies (e.g., MEDDPICC).
  • Extensive background navigating complex government, NATO, and defense procurement frameworks (e.g., NCI Agency, FMS/DCS, national MoD acquisition bodies) across Northern Europe and Allied Command structures, with a focus on key Nordic nations (Sweden, Finland, Norway, Denmark).
  • An established, C-level network across Defense Ministries, Intelligence Agencies, Allied Commands, and European Defense Primes / System Integrators.
  • Deep understanding of how commercial technology and advanced data feeds support Allied posture, sovereign defense, intelligence, and ISR missions.
  • Success collaborating across internal matrixed teams (Government Affairs, Product, Engineering, Legal) to align corporate capabilities with regional opportunities.
  • A strategic, self-directed leader with commercial judgment, adept at leading teams through dynamic, high-growth, or startup-like market environments.
  • Professional working proficiency in English, the language of the company.

What Makes You Stand Out:

  • 5+ years of progressive sales leadership and enterprise business development experience within the defense, national security, or government technology sectors, with a track record of building high-performing teams and consistently exceeding revenue targets.
  • Operational understanding of NATO defense priorities, Nordic security dynamics, joint acquisition processes, and agency decision-making across Allied Ministries of Defense and Tier-1 Defense Primes.
  • Experience managing complex, multi-year deal cycles, with the ability to lead sales teams through disciplined capture frameworks, pipeline governance, and accurate revenue forecasting.
  • Professional proficiency in a Nordic language (Swedish, Finnish, Norwegian, Danish) is a plus for engaging senior government ministers, military command leadership, and internal executives.

About Valiantys

Valiantys helps organizations transform how work gets done across the enterprise, leading with transformation consulting, enterprise service management (ESM), and engineering productivity. By combining deep process expertise with modern collaboration, automation, and value stream practices, Valiantys enables business, IT, and product teams to design connected, efficient, and human-centered ways of working. With a strong focus on the modern workforce, the company helps customers reimagine service delivery beyond IT, streamline cross-functional workflows, and improve flow and throughput for engineering teams. For more information, visit https://valiantys.com.

Job Summary 

As a Principal Managed Services Consultant, you will be a key technical authority within our Managed Services organization, combining hands-on client delivery with technical leadership, innovation, and service development. You will report to the Managed Services Manager. 

You will work with strategic enterprise clients, helping them get the most from their Atlassian Cloud environment. This is not a traditional reactive support role: we expect you to anticipate needs, identify improvement opportunities, challenge existing ways of working, and proactively bring new ideas and solutions to our clients.

Alongside client-facing activities, you will help define the technical direction of the Managed Services team, explore emerging Atlassian Cloud capabilities, and turn new technologies and ideas into scalable services that can be deployed across our client portfolio.

The role is preferably based in Germany and/or requires fluency in both German and English, as you will work closely with one of our enterprise clients, for whom German fluency is essential, as well as with our international teams.
What You’ll Be Working On

Deliver Technical Excellence

• 

Act as a senior technical expert for complex enterprise Atlassian Cloud environments.

• 

Proactively identify risks, recurring issues, and opportunities to improve platform stability, scalability, and adoption.

• 

Provide hands-on support on complex client needs while driving sustainable, long-term solutions.

Shape & Scale Managed Services

• 

Help define the technical direction and standards of our Managed Services practice.

• 

Identify emerging or underused Atlassian Cloud capabilities and turn them into valuable, repeatable client services.

• 

Develop scalable offerings such as health checks, optimization services, and advanced analytics.

Drive Innovation

• 

Explore how Atlassian Analytics, AI, and automation can improve client experience and Managed Services delivery.

• 

Collaborate with international teams to identify and scale successful practices and offerings across regions.

Lead Through Expertise

• 

Act as a technical reference and mentor for the Managed Services team.

• 

Partner with Sales, Delivery, and Transformation Consulting on strategic client engagements and transformation programs.

• 

Promote a proactive, consultative mindset focused on continuous client value.

Do You Have What It Takes?

You bring 8–10+ years of experience in technical consulting, application support, platform operations, or similar enterprise technology environments. You have deep expertise in Atlassian Cloud and a strong understanding of the broader Atlassian ecosystem, its architecture, and best practices.

You are comfortable tackling complex technical challenges and looking beyond immediate fixes to design scalable and sustainable solutions. You can assess client environments, identify areas for improvement, and proactively recommend ways to strengthen performance, governance, adoption, and scalability.

You are curious about emerging technologies and keep up with the latest developments across the Atlassian ecosystem, particularly Atlassian Analytics, AI, automation, and Cloud innovation. You are able to turn new capabilities and ideas into practical solutions that create value for clients.

You combine strong ownership and autonomy with a consultative mindset. You can independently lead technical initiatives, understand and challenge client requirements, and engage confidently with both technical and business stakeholders in complex enterprise environments.

As a Principal Consultant, you naturally share your expertise and influence technical direction, helping colleagues grow and raising standards across the team. You are comfortable collaborating across functions, teams, and international regions.

Fluency in German and English is mandatory

Why Join Valiantys?

At Valiantys, our people are at the heart of everything we do. We are committed to creating an environment where you can grow, lead, and make an impact.

Meaning : Drive strategic transformation projects and influence outcomes
Learning : Continuous development through training, certifications, and communities
Flexibility : Hybrid work model supporting work-life balance

Additional benefits:

• International and multicultural environment

• Flexible remote work policy

• 100% covered health insurance (for you and your family)

• Choice of equipment (PC or Mac)

• Supportive and collaborative culture

Valiantys is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law. Valiantys provides a barrier-free workplace and embraces all qualified applicants with varied perspectives and backgrounds.

Job Title: Data Analyst 

Experience Required: 2-4 years

Role Overview

We are looking for a Data Analyst who can translate product and user data into actionable insights. You will play a critical role in driving data-backed decisions across product, customer success, and leadership teams.

This role requires hands-on experience with analytics tools, strong problem-solving skills, and the ability to build client-facing reports in a B2B SaaS environment.

Key Responsibilities

1. Product & User Analytics

• Analyse user behaviour, funnels, and engagement patterns across the TruLeague platform

• Track key SaaS metrics such as activation, retention, and cohort performance

• Work with tools like Google Analytics and Mixpanel to derive insights

2. Dashboarding & Reporting

• Build and maintain dashboards using Amazon QuickSight

• Create automated and ad-hoc reports for internal teams and external clients

• Ensure accuracy, consistency, and clarity of all data outputs

3. Client-Facing Analytics

• Prepare customer performance reports showcasing engagement, usage trends, and impact

• Translate complex data into simple, actionable insights for non-technical stakeholders

• Work closely with Customer Success teams to support client conversations

4. Data Management & Analysis

• Work extensively with Google Sheets for data cleaning, manipulation, and analysis

• Perform data validation and ensure integrity across multiple sources

• Assist in setting up tracking frameworks and event structures

5. Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Business teams to define metrics and KPIs

• Support experimentation and A/B testing initiatives

• Contribute to building a strong data culture within the organisation

Required Skills & Qualifications

• 24 years of experience in Data Analytics / Product Analytics (preferably SaaS or B2B environment)

• Strong hands-on experience with:

• Google Analytics

• Mixpanel

• Amazon QuickSight

• Google Sheets / Excel

• Good understanding of funnels, cohorts, and user behaviour analytics

• Ability to interpret data and communicate insights clearly

• Strong attention to detail and problem-solving mindset

Good to Have

• Experience with SQL or basic data querying

• Familiarity with SaaS metrics (LTV, CAC, churn, retention)

• Exposure to client-facing reporting or consulting

What Were Looking For

• Someone who is ownership-driven and detail-oriented

• Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment

• Ability to move from data insight action

• Strong communication skills (written and verbal)
